payload.core_mechanism_summary: Triple nested loops iterate over all distinct point triples (a,b,c). For each a, compute dot product of ab and ac. If any dot product >0, mark a as bad and break to next a.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks all triples using simple loops and early exit. No recursion, bitmask, or graph traversal; closest match among candidates is search_backtracking for brute-force enumeration.
